source_interpretation: Two measurement compartments of the same mouse P19 cell model, with fraction pairing labels; not two animal species or independently sourced cell models.

quality_flags.K562_SRSF5: ENCSR906RHU released shRNA reported KD23.1/20.5%; preserve as low efficacy and report SRSF1/SRSF7 subset sensitivity, do not assume equivalent perturbation strength.
quality_flags.HepG2_SRSF5: ENCSR781YNI/Perturb_8096 has direct reported KD67.0/74.9%; choose before expression outcome. ENCSR447UCG/Perturb_8214 retained separately as alternative batch.

limitations: Human shRNA endpoint time unresolved; mouse P19 esiRNA sampled36h.
Cell line/species/study/quantifier and perturbation method are confounded across human and mouse. HepG2/K562 and P19 are distinct tumour-derived cell contexts.
P19 whole/cyto fractions derive from the same sample design; A/B labels do not establish new independent donors. Shared GFP controls and overlapping LOTO training sets limit independence.
P19 raw versus scaled estimated-count export field unresolved; positive library-wide scaling cancels from this composition, but gene-specific quantifier and length effects do not.
Only three related primary SRSF targets. SRSF3 and alternative SRSF5 are supplementary, not a broad independent confirmation.
Historical source choice is reported as an E1 exploratory rule; no validated new-target recommendation, p-values or population confidence intervals.
